kurz: After baking the starch reorganises and firms up. The fridge and low-water doughs speed this up.
bild_im_kopf: Like pudding setting in the fridge: cold puts things in order, warmth loosens them again.

ursachen.warum: At fridge temperature, bread goes stale about six times faster.
fix: Store at room temperature in a cloth

ursachen.warum: Stiff doughs have less water to keep the starch soft.
fix: A little more water in the dough

fix: Use sourdough or a little fat
